messages:
Maya (AE): Quick from QuantBank POC — they asked for a SOC 2 excerpt calling out encryption subcontrols (they referenced CC3.2), a signed pen-test attestation, and a 90-minute authenticated scan window on staging next Thu 13:00 BST. Also asked whether a short dedicated-node trial changes pricing during the POC.
Samir (Solutions Eng): I can pull the SOC2 snippet and a minimal network diagram. For authenticated scans we must provision a read-only test account with scoped permissions; we can't expose any KMS/HSM credentials. If they want a dedicated-node trial we'll need to quote reserved capacity; that pricing conversation should be separate from the evidence handoff but I can get a quick estimate.
Ellen (Security): Authenticated scan requirements: scoped account (app-level read-only), no admin APIs, MFA must be disabled on the test account only during the window, and we need source IPs + UA to fingerprint. We also require DUNS or registration number for the attestation.
Maya (AE): Quant contact: sec-team@quantbank.com. They provided two source IPs: 44.208.77.12 and 44.208.77.13. UA: "QScan-Agent/9.0". They want Thu 12:45 BST -> 14:15 BST. They ask for CC3.2 excerpt specifically.
Raj (Infra): We'll whitelist /32 CIDRs and schedule open/close. Need exact CIDRs and the test account name so we can monitor and rollback on anomalies. Also let us know expected rate to avoid autoscale blips.
Samir (Solutions Eng): Test account name will be quant-poc-scan (read-only). Expected low rate ~25 r/s. We'll rotate credentials immediately after the window and log all activity.
Ellen (Security): We'll review artifacts before sharing. No raw audit logs or KMS material will be included. Also note: include a short exclusion paragraph in the attestation that we don't permit ransomware-style destructive testing.
Maya (AE): Filling LegalBot template fields: signer_name: Helen Zhao; signer_title: Head of Security; company_name: QuantBank Ltd; registration_id: GB-99887766; testing_scope: authenticated external scan of staging endpoints only using provided read-only account; desired_return_email: sec-team@quantbank.com
LegalBot: Received fields. Please confirm whether Quant requires any bespoke indemnity language or regulatory clauses (reply with yes/no and attach text). Once verified we will return a signed PDF within 48 hours.
Maya (AE): Quant replied: no bespoke indemnity, standard wording ok. DUNS not required.
Samir (Solutions Eng): Uploaded SOC2 CC3.2 excerpt + network diagram + test-account steps to presigned S3 (24h): https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence-temp/quantbank/cc3.2-package.zip?X-Amz-Expires=86400
Raj (Infra): Scheduling firewall change: open 44.208.77.12/32 and 44.208.77.13/32 at Thu 12:40 BST, close 14:20 BST. Alerting and auto-rollback if traffic >200 r/s. Please DM the exact credential once created so we can monitor.
Ellen (Security): I'll review the upload and confirm redactions. LegalBot, include the non-destructive testing clause in the attestation and return signed PDF.
LegalBot: Noted. Drafting attestation with non-destructive exclusion; expect signed PDF within 48 hours after security confirms redactions.
Maya (AE): Also asked about dedicated-node pricing — Samir, can you send a quick estimate for a 2-week trial (best-effort)? We'll loop procurement if needed.
Samir (Solutions Eng): Yup — I'll ping pricing and post a two-week estimate in here within EOD.
Maya (AE): Thanks all — passing to Quant: sec-team@quantbank.com. Will update when signed attestation arrives. :white_check_mark:
